notes.name: addresses-show-as-links
notes.title: Web and email addresses look like links
notes.text: An address written out in an email now shows in your link color, even when the email styled it like plain text.

notes.name: all-inboxes-tab
notes.title: All Inboxes is a tab
notes.text: With two accounts or more, All Inboxes sits left of Inbox in the top bar, with its count. Click it, or Tab to it.

notes.name: all-inboxes-tab-no-icon
notes.title: All Inboxes reads like the other tabs
notes.text: The All Inboxes tab in the top bar is now just its name and count, like Inbox, with no icon in front.

notes.name: plain-text-quotes
notes.title: Quoted lines in plain emails read as quotes
notes.text: A plain-text reply's quoted email folds behind "•••" in the quote color, with no ">" at the start of every line.

notes.name: quick-button-tips
notes.title: Button names show the moment you point
notes.text: Rest the pointer on an email's buttons, or the ones above an open email, and its name and key show right away.

notes.name: unsubscribe-email-links
notes.title: Cmd+U finds unsubscribe links that send an email
notes.text: When a newsletter's only way off is an "unsubscribe" link that writes an email, Cmd+U now sends it instead of saying there's no link.

notes.name: up-arrow-stays-in-place
notes.title: The up arrow no longer jumps away
notes.text: In a conversation of long emails, the up arrow now steps back to the end of the email above instead of jumping to its top.

notes.name: drafts-marked-in-lists
notes.title: Drafts are marked in every list
notes.text: Rows with an unsent draft now say Draft, in search and every list, so you can tell drafts from emails you sent.

notes.name: drop-file-on-draft-text
notes.title: Files dropped on your draft attach
notes.text: Dragging a file onto the words of a draft now attaches it. Before, it pasted a link to the file instead.

notes.name: email-cant-name-an-attachment-to-fetch
notes.title: An email can't make Supermail fetch a file
notes.text: An email that hid its own attachment-card address in its pictures could make Supermail ask Gmail for it. Now only Supermail's own cards are fetched.

notes.name: google-no-cookies
notes.title: The app sends Google no cookies
notes.text: Signing in, checking mail and removing an account no longer keep or send any cookies to Google.

notes.name: private-address-pictures
notes.title: Email pictures never load from private addresses
notes.text: An email can no longer make Supermail reach your Mac, iPhone or home network. Pictures from unsecured or private addresses stay hidden.

notes.name: supermail-works-offline
notes.title: Supermail works offline
notes.text: Read, archive, label and answer mail with no connection. What you do and send waits, then goes out once you're back online.

notes.name: email-keeps-room-over-reply
notes.title: The email stays readable above your reply
notes.text: At some text sizes, an open reply squeezed the email above it into a thin strip. It now keeps the room the reply leaves.

notes.name: fyi-always-inbox
notes.title: Tell FYI which senders belong there
notes.text: Pick Always Inbox or Always FYI for any sender. Mail through your company's group addresses, or that a teammate wrote in, stays in Inbox.

notes.name: sign-in-page-error-logs-code-only
notes.title: An unfinished sign-in logs only a code
notes.text: When a sign-in page sends you back without finishing, the app's log keeps only a short error code, never other words.

notes.name: booby-trapped-email-no-longer-stalls-sync
notes.title: A booby-trapped email no longer stops new mail
notes.text: An email built to trip up Supermail could stop new mail arriving for that account. It now comes in like any other.

notes.name: copies-stay-on-device
notes.title: Copied attachments and pictures stay on this device
notes.text: A copied attachment leaves your Mac a minute after you copy something else, or when you quit. iPhone picture copies stay off your other devices.

notes.name: email-text-never-stuck-loading
notes.title: No more emails stuck on Loading
notes.text: An email whose words won't download tries again by itself, then says so with a Try again button instead of showing Loading forever.

notes.name: fyi-tab
notes.title: FYI tab for mail that needs no reply
notes.text: Receipts, sign-in notices, alerts and newsletters move from Inbox to a new FYI tab, so you can read them and clear them in one go.

notes.name: gmail-categories-as-tabs
notes.title: Gmail's categories as tabs, and fix any sender
notes.text: Add Promotions, Social, Updates or Forums as a tab, and set any sender to Always Important or Always Other.

notes.name: mac-drafts-search-fixes
notes.title: Fuller warnings, wider suggestions, smarter from: search
notes.text: A draft's warning shows every word, gray suggestions wrap under a long draft's last line, and from:mike finds Mike by name too.

notes.name: narrow-window-subject
notes.title: Subjects stay readable in a narrow window
notes.text: In a narrow window, an email's buttons move above its subject, so the subject no longer shrinks to a letter a line.

notes.name: new-mail-within-seconds
notes.title: New mail shows up within seconds
notes.text: Postal now checks for new mail every 5 seconds while you're using it, and right away when your Mac wakes or reconnects.

notes.name: readable-at-larger-text-sizes
notes.title: Emails stay visible with bigger text
notes.text: Emails and drafts found through search no longer open as blank pages when you use a larger text size.

notes.name: recent-rows-open
notes.title: Click a recent email to open it
notes.text: The side panel's recent emails with this person now open when you click them. Press Esc to go back to the email you were reading.

notes.name: draft-only-conversation
notes.title: Drafts found in search now open
notes.text: A search that finds an email you started and never sent now shows the draft, marked Draft, instead of a blank page.

notes.name: greeting-outside-only
notes.title: Skip the greeting for coworkers
notes.text: Settings > Writing > Greeting can now greet only people outside your company, so a quick note to a coworker opens with no "Hey".

notes.name: live-labels
notes.title: Labels and folders show new mail right away
notes.text: New mail now appears in an open label, Starred, Sent or All Mail as it arrives. No more leaving and opening it again.

notes.name: zoomable-picture-preview
notes.title: Bigger picture previews you can zoom and copy
notes.text: Pictures open big in their own window. Zoom in to read small print, copy the picture, and keep typing while it's open.

notes.name: answers-between-quotes
notes.title: Answers typed between quoted lines read right
notes.text: A reply with answers typed under each quoted question now shows the questions too. Before, each one hid behind its own "•••".

notes.name: cc-shortcut-one-press
notes.title: Cmd+Shift+C goes straight to Cc
notes.text: One press puts the cursor in Cc, even when Cc is already showing. People on Cc or Bcc are never hidden from the draft.

notes.name: click-outside-preview
notes.title: Click outside a preview to close it
notes.text: A picture or file preview now closes when you click the window around it. Done and Esc still close it too.

notes.name: greeting
notes.title: Start every draft with Hey and their name
notes.text: Turn on Greeting in Settings, Writing. A draft then opens with the first name of whoever is in To, and follows it until you type.

notes.name: greeting-not-a-person
notes.title: No more greeting a company by name
notes.text: A draft to a company, product or team address, like Brightline HQ, now opens with no greeting instead of "Hey Brightline".

notes.name: greeting-word
notes.title: Pick Hey, Hi or just the name
notes.text: The greeting on a new draft can now open with Hey, Hi or only the first name, ending in a comma or a hyphen.

notes.name: list-line-and-numbering
notes.title: Answer under a numbered point with Shift+Return
notes.text: Shift+Return in a list adds a line inside the item, with no new number. Numbered lists recount themselves when you add, delete or split items.

notes.name: quoted-colors-stay
notes.title: Colored answers stay colored inside your reply
notes.text: Show the email inside your reply and its colored words keep their color. The cursor stays where you were typing.

notes.name: reply-stays-in-view
notes.title: Your reply stays in view while you scroll
notes.text: A long reply no longer runs off the window. It stays under the emails with Send in view, and each scrolls on its own.

notes.name: search-suggests-people
notes.title: Search finishes the address you start typing
notes.text: Start typing a name or address in search and Postal shows the person in gray. Press Tab to see every email with them.

notes.name: search-tip-plain-words
notes.title: The search tip is in plain words
notes.text: The line under Search mail now says what to type and what it finds: mail from one person, mail with files, or exact words.

notes.name: send-now
notes.title: Send now, right from the sent popup
notes.text: After you send, the popup offers Send now beside Undo, so the email goes at once. Long popups wrap instead of being cut off.

notes.name: add-gmail-label-button
notes.title: Add Gmail Label says what it does
notes.text: In Settings, the button that turns a Gmail label you already have into an inbox tab is now called Add Gmail Label.

notes.name: color-change-crash
notes.title: Changing colors no longer crashes the app
notes.text: The app could quit by surprise when a color changed while it was getting an email ready to show. That no longer happens.

notes.name: fewer-small-pauses
notes.title: Fewer small pauses
notes.text: Scrolling the inbox, sending a reply and previewing a big attachment no longer make the app stop for a moment.

notes.name: highlight-follows-mouse
notes.title: The highlight follows your mouse
notes.text: Point at an email in the list and it becomes the highlighted one, so E archives it without clicking.

notes.name: paste-email-with-pictures
notes.title: Paste an email with its pictures
notes.text: Paste an email into a new one and it keeps its bold and underline. Pictures from your inbox, Safari or Mail come along as files.

notes.name: voiceover-button-names
notes.title: VoiceOver names every button
notes.text: VoiceOver now reads a name for every icon button, address field and inbox row, even with tooltips turned off.

notes.name: group-sub-tabs
notes.title: See one label inside a group
notes.text: Under a group's tab are small tabs: All, and one per label. Click one, or press ] or [, to see only its mail.

notes.name: phishing-warnings
notes.title: Warnings before you click
notes.text: Emails pretending to be a company or someone you know get a red warning, and links that go somewhere else ask first.

notes.name: settings-label-buttons
notes.title: Tidier buttons under your inbox tabs
notes.text: In Settings, the buttons under your inbox tabs stay on one line each, and move to a second row when they don't fit.

notes.name: all-inboxes
notes.title: See every inbox in one list
notes.text: Press ⌃0 to see all your accounts' emails together, newest first, each marked with its account's letter.

notes.name: all-inboxes-labels
notes.title: Label and remind from All Inboxes
notes.text: H, L and V now work on any email in All Inboxes, using that account's own labels. No switching accounts first.

notes.name: label-chips-stay-whole
notes.title: Labels show in full beside long subjects
notes.text: A label beside a long subject no longer shrinks to a sliver, wraps onto two lines or shifts when your pointer moves over the email.

notes.name: label-groups
notes.title: Group several labels into one tab
notes.text: Put several inbox tabs under one, like your sales reps under Sales. Each email says which one it's from, and Gmail stays the same.

notes.name: menu-labels-fold
notes.title: Your folders stay put in the menu
notes.text: In the ☰ menu, Inbox through Trash no longer scroll away. Labels starts folded: click it to open and scroll just your labels.

notes.name: select-circle
notes.title: Selecting emails looks cleaner
notes.text: Pointing at an email shows an empty circle the size of its dot. A selected email gets a normal checkbox.

notes.name: archive-wording
notes.title: Archive instead of Mark Done
notes.text: E, its buttons and the iPhone swipe now say Archive, and the Done list is called Archive. ⇧E is Move to Inbox.

notes.name: closing-the-window-keeps-mail-coming
notes.title: Closing the window keeps mail coming
notes.text: Close the window and mail keeps coming until you press ⌘Q. The Dock icon or ⌘N brings it back as you left it.

notes.name: every-attached-file-shows
notes.title: Every attached file shows up
notes.text: Files sent without a name, small files packed inside the email, and attached web pages now get their own card instead of disappearing.

notes.name: hidden-pictures-show-as-files
notes.title: Pictures an email hid now show up
notes.text: A picture an email only loads late, or uses as a background, now shows or appears as a file. Forwarded iPhone photos go as files.

notes.name: inline-reply-pictures
notes.title: Inline replies keep the email's pictures
notes.text: When you answer inside the email you're replying to, its pictures now go with your reply as attachments instead of being dropped.

notes.name: instant-switches-current-searches
notes.title: Instant account switches, up-to-date remembered searches
notes.text: Switching to another account no longer flashes an empty list. Reopening a search shows its emails as they are now.

notes.name: iphone-last-email-holds-still
notes.title: The email you're reading holds still
notes.text: A picture loading or failing higher up in the same email no longer moves the words you're reading, even in the last email.

notes.name: learn-how
notes.title: Learn How walks you through one job
notes.text: Help → Learn How shows you, step by step, how to make, color and remove inbox tabs, on a practice inbox. Your real mail stays untouched.

notes.name: long-emails-show-in-full
notes.title: Long emails show in full
notes.text: Long emails that showed only a preview line now show in full. If part won't download, the email says so and tries again.

notes.name: mac-new-mail-notifications
notes.title: New mail notifications on your Mac
notes.text: Important mail now pops up on your Mac with who it's from and the subject. Click it to open the email.

notes.name: odd-emails-never-freeze
notes.title: A strange email can't freeze the app anymore
notes.text: Some emails, built oddly or on purpose, froze the app for seconds or minutes. Now they open, sync and get replies like any other.

notes.name: older-emails-fill-in
notes.title: Older emails fill in when you open them
notes.text: Emails downloaded before this update read again once when you open them, so missing text and files appear. Saved pictures aren't downloaded again.

notes.name: older-emails-keep-their-own-photos
notes.title: Older emails keep their own photos
notes.text: When two emails in a conversation reuse a photo's name, each now shows its own. Mail archived or deleted elsewhere no longer comes back.

notes.name: open-in-gmail
notes.title: Open any email in Gmail
notes.text: Press Cmd+K and pick Open in Gmail to see the email you're reading in Gmail on the web, signed in to the right account.

notes.name: paste-keeps-bold
notes.title: Pasted text keeps its bold and links
notes.text: Copy text with bold, italics, underlines, links or lists and ⌘V keeps them in your email. ⇧⌘V pastes plain text.

notes.name: replies-never-add-hidden-recipients
notes.title: Replies never pick up a hidden recipient
notes.text: A booby-trapped subject line in someone's email can no longer slip a hidden copy of your reply to anyone else.

notes.name: reply-holds-still-while-typing
notes.title: Read the conversation while you type
notes.text: Typing a long reply no longer slides the conversation away. The page moves only when your cursor would leave the window.

notes.name: reply-quote-like-gmail
notes.title: Replies show the email like Gmail does
notes.text: Click ••• under a reply to see the email you're answering, formatted, with room to type above it or answer under any line.

notes.name: right-account-right-recipients
notes.title: New emails start blank, sent as you picked
notes.text: Compose always opens a blank email, and unsent ones wait in Drafts. A picked alias keeps its signature, and replies never add someone nobody picked.

notes.name: search-keeps-part-word-matches
notes.title: Searching part of a word keeps its results
notes.text: Gmail only matches whole words. Emails your Mac found for part of a word now stay, under Also on this Mac.

notes.name: send-and-archive
notes.title: Send & Archive, under its plain name
notes.text: The button beside Send (⌘⇧↵) is now called Send & Archive. It sends your reply and archives the conversation, same as before.

notes.name: sends-go-out-once
notes.title: Every email you send goes out once
notes.text: Quitting right after Send now sends it first. If a send can't be confirmed, you're told plainly, and it's never sent twice.

notes.name: shift-click-select-boxes
notes.title: Shift-click a box to select a run
notes.text: Click one email's box, then Shift-click another's, and every email between is selected. Shift-click a ticked box to unselect the run.

notes.name: smoother-launch-and-attaching
notes.title: Smoother launches, account removal and photo attaching
notes.text: The app no longer slows down after it opens, pauses while removing a big account, or stalls on iPhone while photos attach.

notes.name: sync-catches-up-after-time-away
notes.title: Mail changed elsewhere catches up after time away
notes.text: After time away, archived mail changed on another device updates too. One email Gmail won't send no longer stalls syncing.

notes.name: tall-newsletters-hold-still
notes.title: Tall newsletters stop growing
notes.text: An email with a banner as tall as the window now stays one window tall, instead of growing while you read it.

notes.name: text-after-a-file-shows
notes.title: Text after an attached file now shows
notes.text: Words written below an attachment no longer disappear, and an email whose formatted version is blank shows its plain text instead of nothing.

notes.name: undo-puts-back-exactly
notes.title: Undo puts back exactly what was there
notes.text: Z puts an email back exactly where it was, labels included. Quitting or a Gmail hiccup no longer leaves an email in the wrong place.

notes.name: forward-stops-on-missing-files
notes.title: Forwards never drop a photo quietly
notes.text: If a photo or file from the original can't be downloaded, the forward stops. Try again, or remove it and send.

notes.name: pasted-photos-show-as-cards
notes.title: Photos in an email are never missing
notes.text: Photos pasted into an email show as files to open or download while they load, with no blank gap. They now load first.

notes.name: attachment-download-buttons
notes.title: Download attachments with one click
notes.text: Every attachment now has a download button, and Download All saves them all. Files save to Downloads without opening, and right-click offers more.

notes.name: copy-subject
notes.title: Copy an email's subject
notes.text: Highlight any part of the subject above a conversation and press Cmd+C, or use Cmd+K → Copy Subject for all of it.

notes.name: paperclip-on-folded-emails
notes.title: See which emails in a conversation have files
notes.text: A paperclip now sits by the date on every email with a file, folded or open. Logos and pictures in the text don't count.

notes.name: plain-text-fills-the-pane
notes.title: Plain-text emails fill the page
notes.text: Emails sent as plain text no longer squeeze into a narrow column. Their sentences now run the full width, with paragraphs and lists kept.

notes.name: reminder-dot-color
notes.title: Pick a color for reminder dots
notes.text: Settings → Colors → Separate colors now has Reminder dot. It matches the selection stripe until you pick a color for it.

notes.name: side-panel-links
notes.title: Click a sender's address or website
notes.text: In the side panel, click someone's address to write them a new email, or their company's domain to open its website.

notes.name: trash-beside-done
notes.title: Trash sits right next to Done
notes.text: Open an email and the trash can is now right beside the checkmark, so deleting takes one click. Z brings it back.

notes.name: account-picture-mac
notes.title: Give each account its own picture
notes.text: In Settings, pick a photo for any account or drop one on its circle. It shows beside the account, on this Mac only.

notes.name: apple-mail-attachments
notes.title: Files sent from Apple Mail always show
notes.text: Files sent from Apple Mail now always show as attachments, even in a reply with nothing typed. Those replies used to look empty.

notes.name: color-themes
notes.title: Save your own color themes
notes.text: Change any color in Settings → Colors and save the mix as a theme of your own, then switch themes in one click.

notes.name: compose-button
notes.title: A Compose button at the top
notes.text: Click the pencil at the top right to start a new email. It does the same as pressing C.

notes.name: dark-mode-plain-notices
notes.title: Plain emails match dark mode
notes.text: Emails that bring their own dark colors now read in your theme's colors, and text on a white email never touches its edge.

notes.name: double-click-copies-address
notes.title: Double-click an address to copy just it
notes.text: In an email's From and To details, a double click picks the whole email address, so Cmd+C copies only the address.

notes.name: download-attachments
notes.title: Download all of an email's attachments
notes.text: Download all saves every attachment in an email to Downloads at once. A picture you open big has a Download button too (Cmd+S).

notes.name: no-gray-haze-in-cards
notes.title: No gray haze in Cmd+K, toasts or replies
notes.text: Cmd+K, search, the Undo toast, To's suggestions, the reply box and the other boxes no longer have a gray smudge around their words.

notes.name: resize-side-panel
notes.title: Make the side panel wider or narrower
notes.text: In an open email, drag the left edge of the panel on the right to resize it. Double-click the edge to put it back.

notes.name: select-with-the-mouse
notes.title: Select several emails with the mouse
notes.text: Click the box by an email, Command-click, or Shift-click a run to select several. Star, Read and Trash show when you point at an email.

notes.name: shortcuts-and-buttons
notes.title: Buttons for everything, or keys only
notes.text: Star, Trash, Search, formatting and more now have buttons you can click. To keep just the keys, pick Shortcuts only in Settings, Shortcuts.

notes.name: slash-slash-advanced-search
notes.title: Press / twice for Advanced Search
notes.text: Press / to search, then / again before typing anything, and the Advanced Search fields open. Once you've typed, / types normally.

notes.name: private-settings-and-log
notes.title: Your settings and log stay encrypted
notes.text: Your email addresses, label names and log no longer sit in plain files or iPhone backups. Help → Privacy Policy opens our privacy page.

notes.name: side-menu-settings
notes.title: Settings in the side menu
notes.text: Open ☰ at the top left and Settings is right there, above Send Feedback.

notes.name: gray-accent-buttons
notes.title: Gray accents no longer dim your buttons
notes.text: With a gray accent, Cancel, Undo and other buttons now show in your text color instead of a gray that looked switched off.

notes.name: advanced-search
notes.title: Search with Gmail's search options form
notes.text: The sliders button in search, or Cmd+K → Advanced Search, opens fields for From, To, Subject, dates, size and where to look.

notes.name: aliases-are-me
notes.title: Mail from your other addresses says me
notes.text: Mail you send from another of your Gmail addresses, like sales@, now says "me" in conversations and the inbox, as in Gmail.

notes.name: attachment-check
notes.title: Catch a forgotten attachment before it sends
notes.text: If your email says something is attached and nothing is, Supermail asks before sending. Settings → Writing turns it off.

notes.name: colors
notes.title: Pick your colors
notes.text: Settings → Colors has background themes and separate colors for buttons, accounts and Super Labels.

notes.name: reply-from-address
notes.title: Replies go from the address mail came to
notes.text: Answer an email sent to another of your Gmail addresses and the reply goes from that one. On the Mac, ⌘⇧F picks a different one.

notes.name: settings-sync
notes.title: Your settings follow you
notes.text: Colors, swipes, shortcuts and your other choices now match on your Macs and iPhone through iCloud.

notes.name: signature
notes.title: See your Gmail signature in Settings
notes.text: Settings → your account shows the Gmail signature Supermail adds to every email you send.

notes.name: text-selection
notes.title: Pick the color of selected text
notes.text: Selected text in emails and drafts now uses your accent color. Pick another in Settings → Colors → Text selection.

notes.name: undo-send-time
notes.title: Choose how long Undo Send waits
notes.text: Settings → Writing sets 5, 10, 20 or 30 seconds to take back an email after you press Send. It follows you to your other devices.

notes.name: vacation-reminder
notes.title: See when your vacation responder is on
notes.text: A small reminder sits in the top bar while Gmail's vacation responder is on, with a quick way to turn it off.

notes.name: whats-new
notes.title: See what's new in each update
notes.text: Cmd+K → What's New lists what each update changed, with a picture of each.

notes.name: labels
notes.title: Make a label right from L
notes.text: Type a new name in the label box to create that Gmail label. Z undoes any label you add or remove.

notes.name: search-sentence
notes.title: Search by typing a sentence
notes.text: Type "quotes from Dana about the tubes" and Supermail turns it into the right search. It runs on your Mac with Apple Intelligence.

notes.name: smart-compose
notes.title: Smart Compose finishes your sentences
notes.text: Gray words suggest the rest of your sentence as you type. Press Tab to add them, or keep typing to skip them.

notes.name: encrypted
notes.title: Your mail is locked on your Mac
notes.text: Supermail now encrypts the mail, drafts and pictures it keeps on your Mac. Nothing changes in how you use it.

notes.name: rich-text
notes.title: Bold, italics and lists in your emails
notes.text: Make words bold or italic, or start a list. Select words and paste a web address to turn them into a link.

notes.name: side-menu
notes.title: A side menu for every folder
notes.text: Open ☰ at the top left for Sent, Drafts, Done, Spam, Trash and every Gmail label.

notes.name: picture-big
notes.title: Click a picture to see it big
notes.text: Pictures in emails open full size with a click. Attached pictures and PDFs show a preview too.

notes.name: select-many
notes.title: Act on many emails at once
notes.text: Press X or ⇧J to pick several emails, then E, H, L or # handles all of them.

notes.name: tutorial
notes.title: Learn the keys on a practice inbox
notes.text: Cmd+K → Tutorial walks you through the main shortcuts. It uses a practice inbox, so your real mail stays untouched.
